messages.subject: convert correlations to covariance
parts:
hey, all, 
I have a model with 10 variables, I did data screening and EFA first, now I am in the phase of CFA.  
Before I use cor2cov()  to convert my correlation matrix into a covariance matrix. , I need a correlation table first, I use lav_matrix_lower2full():
model.cor <- lav_matrix_lower2full(c(1,
                                     0.568,1,
                                     0.588,0.455,1
                                     0.086,0.253,-0.071,1
                                     0.072,0.021,-0.220,0.064,1
                                     0.623,0.484,0.452,0.243,0.136,1
                                     -0.241,-0.501,-0.161,0.121,-0.157,-0.067,1
                                     0.389,0.328,0.235,0.358,0.213,0.558,0.145,1
                                     0.212,0.129,0.415,-0,090,-0.243,0.215,0.076,0.093,1
                                     0.352,0.319,0.348,0.230,-0.057,0.447,0.124,0.469,0.295,1))
and then it shows me :
> model.cor <- lav_matrix_lower2full(c(1,
+                                      0.568,1,
+                                      0.588,0.455,1
+                                      0.086,0.253,-0.071,1
Error: unexpected numeric constant in:
"                                     0.588,0.455,1
                                     0.086"

could you help me, please :-) what is wrong with my steps, or is there any better solutions for it?

Thank you all in advance.

best regards,
Min
